title: The v1 narrow/general/superintelligent split is unsourced
summary: Current systems, hypothetical human-level systems, and superintelligence are a scheme we did not tie to one canonical paper.
body: The v1 AI article defines narrow AI as all current systems, general AI as not yet existing, and superintelligence as a philosophical debate, then lists jobs, bias, surveillance, autonomous weapons, and existential risk. AlphaFold is a sourced application. Turing is a sourced paper. The three-way taxonomy and the risk list mix definitions, predictions, and political arguments. They are unsourced as a bundle. Bias in a specific system needs a specific audit, not a heading.

legacy.note: v1 truthScore and source-count fields are not evidence and are not copied.
